mutations.name: CX-REMOVE
mutations._mechanism: Cut only the caller's listing connection; the matcher remains intact.

mutations.name: CX-FORCE
mutations._mechanism: Force a listed result at the caller with the matcher intact.
mutations.replace: listed = judge.Listing("listed", min(names, key=lambda p: p.name), None, "")  # M:CX-LIST

mutations.name: AG-REMOVE
mutations._mechanism: Cut only the caller's listing connection; the matcher remains intact.

mutations.name: AG-FORCE
mutations._mechanism: Force a listed result at the caller with the matcher intact.
mutations.replace: listed = judge.Listing("listed", min(names, key=lambda p: p.name), None, "")  # M:AG-LIST

mutations.name: CL-REMOVE
mutations._mechanism: Cut only the listing call; keep the caller and callee intact.

mutations.name: CL-FORCE
mutations._mechanism: Force the canonical target to be listed without consulting the matcher.
